source.snippet: VictoriaLogs vs Loki, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, SigNoz and ClickStack on structured log ingestion (tags: databases, devops, performance)

problem_statement: DevOps and platform engineering teams struggle to choose and justify the right log ingestion backend as the landscape fragments across VictoriaLogs, Loki, Elasticsearch, ClickHouse-based stacks, and others — each with different cost and performance tradeoffs at scale.
target_segment: Platform engineers and DevOps leads at startups and scale-ups managing self-hosted or cloud observability stacks.
notes: Benchmark comparison content draws sustained traffic from engineering teams actively evaluating stacks — these teams have budget (cloud infra spend is a real cost center). A managed benchmarking or migration advisory service, or a cost-modelling SaaS that helps teams pick the cheapest stack for their log volume, would find paying buyers among engineering leads with $10k+/month infra bills.
